name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood summers spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm. He pursued mechanical engineering at Tampere University of Technology, where he specialized in precision machining. His passion led him to secure an apprenticeship at a local rally team, honing his skills in fabricating and maintaining high-performance components.

Before joining Trident, Jari worked for a renowned Finnish manufacturer of racing engines, where he gained extensive experience in working with exotic materials and advanced manufacturing techniques. He is known for his meticulous approach, ensuring that every part meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. Jari's colleagues appreciate his adaptability and willingness to collaborate on complex engineering challenges. He's always striving to improve the performance and durability of the car through meticulous attention to detail.

He believes in a proactive approach to problem-solving, constantly seeking opportunities to optimize the car's mechanical systems. Jari's dedication and expertise make him a valuable asset to the Trident team.

physical.description: Jari is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a task.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Finnish coffee.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on intricate work.
